name: Eco-Conscious Executive Emma
motivation: Seeks high-performance luxury skincare that is ethically sourced and non-comedogenic.
pain_points: Harsh synthetic chemicals, sticky summer formulas, lack of brand transparency.
shopping_behavior: Researches ingredient lists on TikTok/Reddit before purchasing on mobile web.

name: Tech Pioneer Tyler
motivation: Desires state-of-the-art sustainable EV tech without sacrificing design elegance.
pain_points: Range anxiety, slow charging speeds, outdated automotive interior infotainment.
shopping_behavior: Attends tech expos, reads technical whitepapers, pre-orders online directly.

name: Marathon Runner Maya
motivation: Optimizes physical recovery windows using telemetry biometrics.
pain_points: Inaccurate smartwatch sensors, weak battery life during ultra-marathons.
shopping_behavior: Buys through athletic community recommendations and athlete sponsorships.
